entities.summary: Philippine Commonwealth, a political institution in Philippines during Philippine-American War and Colonial Period (1901–1941). Grew from Treaty of Paris. Led to the emergence of Tydings-McDuffie Act and Battle of Bud Dajo — US forces massacre Moro villagers in Sulu.
